title: Longleaf Pines | KEY.co
description_expanded: Beyond the home, the community itself enhances the experience with its array of amenities, including a sparkling pool, children’s playground, and scenic walking trails. With two adult bikes provided, exploring the nearby Gulfview Heights Beach access is effortless, offering a quick escape to sugar-white sands, picnic shelters, and lifeguarded waters during peak season. For those seeking adventure or leisure, the vibrant 30A corridor awaits with boutique shops, local seafood eateries, and iconic spots like Grayton Beach State Park and Seaside. Whether you're relaxing on the balcony, grilling on the Red Egg charcoal smoker, or joining a seasonal beach bonfire, this getaway promises an unforgettable journey to the laid-back luxury of the Emerald Coast. Nestled within a tranquil gated community in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach, this charming coastal retreat offers the perfect escape for families and groups seeking a blend of comfort and elegance. Designed to accommodate multi-generational gatherings, the home features four thoughtfully appointed bedrooms, including a convenient first-floor king suite. The interiors exude warmth and relaxation, with plush furnishings that invite you to unwind after sun-soaked days on 30A’s pristine beaches. Step onto the balcony for serene moments surrounded by nature, or savor family meals prepared in the fully equipped kitchen, complete with a gas stove and every modern convenience.
